selectionAvailabilityNotes: PrizePicks public projections API does not expose explicit button-enabled state for More/Less.
Standard projections are normalized as over/under unless the market is known or observed as one-sided.
Takedowns are marked over-only from in-app UI observation supplied by the user.
Adjusted demon/goblin projections are normalized as over-only adjusted projections because the API exposes them as separate one-sided thresholds.
